info.name: Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 Abort Usage API

params.name: page
params.description: Number of the page you want returned. Starts at 0. If you don’t specify a value or if you specify 0, the first page is returned.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of usage entries per page. Defaults to 100.
